stage: first slice: the form-and-placement chain of a simple thing, against the readers

result.chain: a simple thing is FORM plus PLACEMENT: 177 catalogued forms (11 kits, 11 model scenes) and 282 placements (86 props and 196 kit placements) all resolve, every asset path exists, and every transform reads
result.shapes the readers really use: a catalogue entry names its node either through source.node or through source.prefix (the modular kits); a prop carries a SCALAR optional scale with the runtime default 1 while a kit placement carries a required THREE-number scale vector (KitPlacementTakeover reads it with ToVector3); yawDegrees is optional with the default 0
result.authoring states: 100 placements are retired from the game, one is hidden and some carry an original position after being moved; these are states the editor must show and preserve, not defects
result.boundary: reshaping a form means changing the kit model or its generator, which is the model track (AI-09/AI-11/AI-36): this slice guarantees the link, the asset and the placement, and says so instead of implying a Studio field could reshape a mesh

verified.probe: PASS 418/418 with the new checks: the catalogue, 282 placements with no problems, a prop naming its form through the catalogue, a kit placement naming its asset source, the authoring states reported as states, and the synthetic cases (a catalogue entry without a scene or node, a degenerate size, a missing licence, a prop whose form is missing, a two-number position, an unsupported asset scheme)
verified.compile: Urman.Studio.Core 0 warnings/0 errors; game/Urman.Game.csproj 0 warnings/0 errors
verified.not_run: no game run: how a form looks on screen is a matter for the in-game view, NOT_RUN

own_mistakes: three wrong assumptions were caught by the probe on real data before this commit: I first required source.node (111 modular kit entries use source.prefix), treated scale as a scalar everywhere (196 kit placements carry a vector and the runtime reads it as one), and required scale at all (a prop without it takes the runtime default 1)
open: the shape editor itself depends on AI-09/AI-11/AI-36 and is NOT_RUN
